title: Flute
summary: A musical instrument, probably composed of a number of pipes, mentioned Dan. 3:5, 7, 10, 15.

inlines.v: A musical instrument, probably composed of a number of pipes, mentioned Dan. 3:5, 7, 10, 15.
In Matt. 9:23, 24, notice is taken of players on the flute, here called "minstrels" (but in R.V. "flute-players").
Flutes were in common use among the ancient Egyptians.
